confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings, booking pages, or city-price searches were used. Restaurant and hostel anchors are steadier; hotel rates are least certain given July peak-season variability. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct local bar and wine pricing knowledge is weak. FX value comes from search results citing RBA pages; the live page was not opened and cached-copy dates could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of other Vietnamese coastal resort cities such as Da Nang and Hoi An, adjusted upward for Nha Trang's July peak-season demand; no live price checks were made.
